# DARMA mandatory SEO and design review

- [ ] No unapproved change to the user's LOCKED screenshot, section order or color system.
- [ ] One meaningful H1 and correct Persian RTL semantic markup.
- [ ] Distinct title, description, canonical, indexability and helpful internal links.
- [ ] No fabricated products, prices, stock, ratings, discounts, reviews, addresses or sales figures.
- [ ] JSON-LD mirrors real server-rendered product and offer data in IRR; never guessed.
- [ ] No accidental robots, CDN, sitemap or canonical regression; staging remains noindex.
- [ ] Product image source and copyrights verified; correct alt, sizes, optimized delivery.
- [ ] Mobile responsive, accessible keyboard interaction, performance budgets assessed.
- [ ] npm run seo:static + typecheck + build + seo:smoke pass.
- [ ] Before/after screenshot, SEO impact, query/page intent and tests documented.

Do not merge if unmet. Human review remains mandatory even when CI passes.
